status: Test-only preregistration. Positive control is the unchanged scalar kernel; no nonlinear SIMD backend or speedup has been implemented or demonstrated.
purpose: Potential speedup of the complete nonlinear Ig00156PhaseCorrection::process across independent HP/LP filter lanes with exactly the scalar operation order and all observable continuation state preserved. A prior within-stage column-layout trial failed signed-zero/FE_DOWNWARD equality; it is not revived by this registration.

frozen_oracle.generation: tests/cpu/materialize-frozen-scalar-kernels.py performs the sealed namespace-only transformation; the new test consumes that existing frozen artifact, never the live candidate math.
frozen_oracle.independence: Each lane has its own original frozen Ig00156PhaseCorrection instance and its own source instance. No candidate function, new coefficient/cache helper, shared state or clock scheduler is invoked by the frozen comparator. Standard runtime math may be shared, as in the parent frozen contract.

baseline_positive_control.mode: The unchanged source Phase::process is called directly once per participating lane; there are zero SIMD backend entries and no attempted reduced work.
baseline_positive_control.requirement: All exact-bit assertions pass before changing phase source or adding a vector backend. The frozen header and fixture grid are never regenerated from an optimized candidate.

grid.networks: Alternate the original nominal HP and LP in a batch; independent per-lane control schedule and seed.
grid.denormal_modes: All writable x86 FTZ/DAZ combinations; AArch64 FPCR.FZ modes where available; otherwise report unsupported variants, do not fake support.
grid.transitions: Change rounding at sample 512 and return at 1024; change denormal control at 2048 and return at 3072 with saved physical/history state intact.
grid.controls: Each lane independently uses fixed pairs, a moving cutoff/Q schedule, or 257-sample control changes; each set() must preserve the source's floating-point control bits.
grid.inputs: Deterministic hard-noise drive with original xorshift stream, and explicit final-step signed zero, subnormal, minimum normal, infinity and quiet-NaN bit patterns.
grid.lane_mask: (sample + lane) % 13 != 0; an inactive lane has no process() call, state write, current update, residual change or history advancement, and must retain its source-equivalent state.
grid.state_events: Snapshot lane at sample 512; copy the first lane to the final lane at 1024 (when width > 1); restore selected lanes at 2048; reset selected lanes at 3072; unaffected lanes continue.
comparisons_each_sample: HP/BP/LP binary32 output for every participating lane
four physical binary64 nodes and four causal binary64 input-history coordinates for all lanes, including masked lanes
binary64 input rate, both Newton predictor slopes, both accepted OTA tanh currents
binary64 accepted solver residual and integral Newton correction count
preserved caller FP control after source and frozen set/process
grid.equality: IEEE bit equality including the sign of zero and NaN payload wherever the original scalar result is defined. Maximum allowed output/state/residual ULP is 0; Newton correction difference is 0.

candidate_constraints.scope: Full nonlinear phase calculation including RHS, initial predictor, sequential per-lane fastTanh and convergence, Newton refinement, state/output commit. Each lane may converge on a different iteration; masked or converged lanes must never receive spurious work/state mutations.
candidate_constraints.ordering: Preserve original per-lane multiplication/addition and 4x4 / 3x3 reduction order, floating-point exceptional behavior, each lane's HP->LP dependency and eventual engine rank/mix ordering. Do not batch across a dependency edge.
candidate_constraints.compiler: No global fast-math, FMA contraction policy change, reassociation, reciprocal approximation, relaxed transcendental, precision reduction, or global FP-mode override.
candidate_constraints.dispatch: A backend must be guarded by actual ISA and FP-mode support; use the exact unchanged scalar fallback for unqualified width, rounding, FTZ/DAZ or exceptional input. Baseline binaries must not emit unguarded new-ISA instructions.
candidate_constraints.compatibility: No acceptance pin or hardware claim changes. Exact legacy, legacy-tails, V1 and current V2 captures remain byte-identical, with all existing independent circuit, clock, idle, event, oscillator and physical gates retained.

candidate_specific_true_work_witness.status: Registered now, not met by positive scalar control; a prospective backend is required for nonzero counts.
candidate_specific_true_work_witness.instrumentation: In a separate test-only build, add counters at the actual batch-kernel entry, vectorized nonlinear arithmetic iteration and per-lane state commit; separately count calls to the unchanged scalar process() fallback. Counter increments must occur at real code sites and be reset/read from a controlled single-threaded test, not wrapper assumptions or selected metadata flags.
candidate_specific_true_work_witness.required_on_qualified_backend: At least one real backend entry and one vector nonlinear iteration for each supported width 4/8/16 with FE_TONEAREST on hardware where that implementation claims support; total backend active-lane commits must equal its active mask's population; no scalar process() call may replace a lane claimed as vector-qualified. Mixed convergence/partial masks must prove correct per-lane iteration counts. Width 1, unsupported FP modes, scalar remainders and exceptional cases may fall back and must be explicitly counted.
candidate_specific_true_work_witness.negative_witnesses: Individually force the candidate's dispatch to scalar-only despite a qualified vector case, suppress one real vector batch/active-lane commit, or process one masked-off lane. Each mutation must compile and fail a named ordinary assertion, not merely degrade timing.
candidate_specific_true_work_witness.no_shipping_telemetry: Temporary counters and probes must not persist in shipping DSP state or alter audio arithmetic. A work-count improvement alone never qualifies an end-to-end CPU target.

negative_controls.status: Test-harness candidate-call mutations before implementation; actual backend source mutations are mandatory after implementation.
negative_controls.CS80_PHASE_LANE_MUTATE_OUTPUT: Toggle one bit in a computed LP output for lane 0/sample 1 and require FAIL lane.output[0] with ordinary exit 1.
negative_controls.CS80_PHASE_LANE_MUTATE_MASK: Run candidate process on an excluded lane 0/sample 0 and require a phase.state/history FAIL with ordinary exit 1.
negative_controls.CS80_PHASE_LANE_MUTATE_CROSS_LANE: Alter lane 1/sample 1 candidate drive only; require output and/or physical-state FAIL with ordinary exit 1.
negative_controls.mutation_protocol: Each controlled mutation must separately compile successfully and terminate under the original test oracle with a named equality failure, while the unmodified positive control passes again. A crash, compiler failure, timeout or changed frozen fixture is not a mutation kill.

qualification.test_only_first: Commit and validate this preregistration by itself, without changing DSP source. Implement no backend until baseline and mutation controls are demonstrated and registration publicly reviewable.
qualification.complete_tests: Run this independent oracle, the pre-existing full exact scalar suite, all CTest core tests, source compatibility gates, and strict byte-identity pins from the current feature head before source eligibility.
qualification.cpu: After a fully qualified candidate, use three serial before and three serial after cs80_source_factory_benchmark rounds on the same uncontended host at 48000 Hz, 256 frames, 8 held voices and quiet idle. Preserve all 51 fixture checksums/peaks/RMS, every per-preset median and p99, budget misses, Legacy controls and raw outliers; no timing from an instrumented build. Hard source targets: held RTF 0.15-0.20 and quiet-idle RTF <=0.02, both still RED.
qualification.publication: No production integration, PR/main merge, audio re-pin or release until all exact numerical, physical and absolute CPU gates pass. Rejected or inconclusive experiments remain on separately labeled branches.
